issues.title: M1: M1-28 Light survival needs: hunger and thirst never kill
issues.excerpt: Decision "Survival needs are light" (docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-08): hunger and thirst never kill. Today EL_SurvivalStats.UpdateStats drains hunger at 0.1/s and thirst at 0.15/s, so a player reaches 20 within 9 to 13 minutes.
issues.why: Decision "Survival needs are light" (docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-08): hunger and thirst never kill. Today EL_SurvivalStats.UpdateStats drains hunger at 0.1/s and thirst at 0.15/s, so a player reaches 20 within 9 to 13 minutes. Below 20, health falls at 0.05/s until death. A one-hour playtest would end in starvation deaths. The rates are hard-coded.
work: Move drain rates and effects into config (framework). Flagship: slow drain, so a meal lasts a long session.
Clamp the frame delta in EL_CharacterSurvivalComponent so a hitch does not drop a big chunk.
The cap and the stamina effect show in the world first (slower sprint, heavier breathing), the survival HUD second.
proof: Suite: LOGIC survival/light: at zero hunger and thirst, health stops at the cap and never reaches zero; drain rates come from config.
Harness (player view): a dedicated client with hunger and thirst at 0 stays alive; state shows health at the cap.
Clip: n/a
Needs the rendering game: no for the suite; the stamina feel needs a look in game.

issues.title: M1: M1-27 Murder makes you wanted; the spawn is a safe zone
issues.excerpt: Decision "Killing anyone makes you wanted for murder; the spawn is a safe zone" (docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-08).
issues.why: Decision "Killing anyone makes you wanted for murder; the spawn is a safe zone" (docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-08). Today only robberies, breaches, and the hospital raise wanted (EL_RobAction, EL_RobVehicleAction, EL_RobWeaponAction, LF_Breach, LF_Hospital). A kill raises nothing, and nothing stops a player shooting fresh arrivals at the spawn plaza.
work: On the server, a player killing another character (player or civilian NPC) records a murder.
Self-kills and deaths with no killer do not count. A kill by an on-duty officer of a wanted suspect does not count by default (config).
A safe zone around the spawn plaza (radius is config, placed with the plaza by M1-25). Damage from one player to another inside it is refused.
The plaza sign card says it is a safe zone (M1-09 text).
Repeat offenders are an admin matter. No automatic ban or kick.
proof: Suite: LOGIC crime/murder: a kill raises wanted once; self-kill and officer-on-wanted kill do not.
Harness (player view): 2 clients on dedicated. A kills B outside the plaza; state shows A wanted, and the police board shows a description...
Clip: A shot refused at the spawn.
Needs the rendering game: yes (needs-game)

issues.title: M1-26: Wake up in hospital

Death has no cost beyond what the body carried, and the world does not show where you went.
work: Respawn puts the player in a hospital bed at the hospital site (a vanilla bed prop), not at the spawn plaza.
Waking charges a small hospital bill from the bank balance. A player who cannot cover it goes into debt: the balance goes negative, and later deposits pay it...
The player learns the bill in the world first: a paper bill item or a short card on waking, then a toast.
Server-side only: the bill and the bed choice are decided on the server; the client never sends an amount.
Log every charge and every debt through EL_Debug.Info("Respawn", ...).
proof: Suite: LOGIC respawn/bill: bill taken once per death; a broke player goes negative by the bill; a later deposit clears the debt first.
Harness (player view): dedicated client dies, respawns, state shows position at a hospital bed and bank balance reduced by the bill; repeat...
Clip: die, wake in the hospital bed, read the bill.
Needs the rendering game: yes (needs-game)
